desc.en: Map tools that work like clockwork. Fifty thousand free monthly queries (map tiles, db2vector, elevation).
desc.zh: 如钟表般精准运行的地图工具。每月免费 5 万次查询（地图瓦片、db2vector、海拔高程）。

desc.en: Location discovery, venue search, and context-aware content from Places API and Pilgrim SDK.
desc.zh: 通过 Places API 和 Pilgrim SDK 提供位置发现、场所搜索和情境感知内容。

desc.en: Vector and raster map tiles, geocoding, places, routing, isolines APIs. Three thousand free requests/day.
desc.zh: 矢量与栅格地图瓦片、地理编码、地点、路线规划、等值线 API。每天免费 3,000 次请求。

desc.en: Geocoding via API or CSV Upload. Two thousand five hundred free queries/day.
desc.zh: 通过 API 或 CSV 上传进行地理编码。每天免费 2,500 次查询。

desc.en: Geocoding and Geoparsing via API or CSV Upload. 10k free queries/month.
desc.zh: 通过 API 或 CSV 上传进行地理编码与地理文本解析。每月免费 1 万次查询。

desc.en: Highly available REST/JSON/JSONP IP Geolocation lookup API.
desc.zh: 高可用的 REST/JSON/JSONP IP 地理位置查询 API。

desc.en: Geocoding API with language correction and more. Worldwide coverage. 2,500 free daily queries
desc.zh: 地理编码 API，具备语言纠正等功能。覆盖全球。每天免费 2,500 次查询。

desc.en: A free developer package is offered for Routing, Route Optimization, Distance Matrix, Geocoding, and Map Matching.
desc.zh: 为路线规划、路线优化、距离矩阵、地理编码和地图匹配提供免费开发者软件包。

desc.en: APIs and SDKs for maps and location-aware apps. 250k transactions/month for free.
desc.zh: 面向地图和位置感知应用的 API 与 SDK。每月免费 25 万次事务。

desc.en: Free DEVELOPER plan available with 30K requests/month.
desc.zh: 提供免费开发者套餐，每月 3 万次请求。

desc.en: Locate and identify Website Visitors by IP Address
desc.zh: 通过 IP 地址定位并识别网站访客。

desc.en: Geocoding, reverse geocoding, places, static maps, and vector map tiles APIs. Free tier includes 3,000 geocoding requests/day, 300 reverse geocoding requests/day, and 100 static map images/day.
desc.zh: 地理编码、逆地理编码、地点、静态地图和矢量地图瓦片 API。免费套餐含每天 3,000 次地理编码请求、300 次逆地理编码请求和 100 张静态地图图片。

desc.en: Geocoding, Maps, and Routing APIs. Five thousand requests/day for free.
desc.zh: 地理编码、地图和路线规划 API。每天免费 5,000 次请求。

desc.en: Maps, geospatial services and SDKs for displaying map data.
desc.zh: 用于展示地图数据的地图、地理空间服务和 SDK。

desc.en: Free map tiles and tile hosting.
desc.zh: 免费地图瓦片及瓦片托管。

desc.en: Vector maps, map services and SDKs for map visualization. Free vector tiles with weekly updates and four map styles.
desc.zh: 用于地图可视化的矢量地图、地图服务和 SDK。免费矢量瓦片，每周更新，提供 4 种地图样式。

desc.en: OpenStreetMap's free geocoding service, providing global address search functionality and reverse geocoding capabilities.
desc.zh: OpenStreetMap 的免费地理编码服务，提供全球地址搜索功能和逆地理编码能力。

desc.en: Geocoding API aggregating OpenStreetMap and other open geo sources. Two thousand five hundred free queries/day.
desc.zh: 聚合 OpenStreetMap 和其他开放地理数据源的地理编码 API。每天免费 2,500 次查询。

desc.en: Geocoding, search results ranked by the popularity of related Wikipedia page.
desc.zh: 地理编码，搜索结果按相关 Wikipedia 页面的热度排名。

desc.en: Free geocoding for global places and coordinates. 25,000 Requests per month for personal use.
desc.zh: 面向全球地点和坐标的免费地理编码。个人使用每月 25,000 次请求。

desc.en: Map tiles, routing, navigation, and other geospatial APIs. Two thousand five hundred free map views and API requests/day for non-commercial usage and testing.
desc.zh: 地图瓦片、路线规划、导航及其他地理空间 API。非商业用途和测试每天免费 2,500 次地图浏览和 API 请求。

desc.en: In-browser SQL workspace with free tools including a JOIN visualizer, SQL formatter, CSV/JSON to SQL converters, and practice questions with no account or credit card required.
desc.zh: 浏览器内 SQL 工作区，提供免费工具，包括 JOIN 可视化器、SQL 格式化工具、CSV/JSON 转 SQL 转换器和练习题；无需账户或信用卡。
